election: San Francisco Board of Supervisors - District 7
notes: PrefLib file 00021-00000014.toi (dataset 00021, 'sf'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 122 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

label_sources.official_winners: Wikipedia, "2012 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election" (winner boxes; cites the San Francisco Department of Elections).
label_sources.max_ranks: Alameda County and San Francisco ranked-choice ballots allowed 3 rankings (every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).

label_notes: PrefLib's title has no year; the candidates (Crowley, Engardio, Yee and others) are the 2012 District 7 field.
